content.short: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol built on Ethereum that provides a crypto-native yield-bearing stablecoin.
content.description: Ethena is a groundbreaking synthetic dollar protocol that introduces USDe, a censorship-resistant and scalable stablecoin built on the Ethereum blockchain. By utilizing delta-neutral hedging strategies against staked ETH collateral, Ethena ensures that USDe maintains its peg while generating native yield for holders. The protocol also features the 'Internet Bond,' a global dollar-denominated savings instrument that democratizes access to sophisticated financial products. Ethena focuses on decentralization and transparency, providing a robust alternative to traditional centralized stablecoins. As a vital engine for capital efficiency, Ethena drives innovation and stability within the decentralized finance landscape, empowering users with a reliable and productive digital dollar.
content.meta: Ethena provides a crypto-native synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum, offering USDe and the yield-bearing Internet Bond for Web3 users.
